tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Lists the insurance products a quote can be requested for, with the quote form fields of each (path, label, required, options). Fields with `input: "lookup"` take a code from a list, which search_field_options returns; `dependsOn` lists the fields whose values that list needs first. No sign-in neede

tools.name: search_field_options
tools.description: Searches the options of a list field (`input: "lookup"` in list_products), such as occupation, brand, model, usage type or coverage limit. tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Returns the state of a quote run: its offers (each with an `offerRef` and its `coverages`: the company's coverage lines as `title` and `value`; offers also differ in their main coverages, not only in price), the companies that gave no offer with the reason (`failures[].reason`, `category`, `retryabl

tools.name: select_offer
tools.description: Selects one offer (`offerRef`) of a quote run. Replaces an earlier selection of the same run. Premium and validity are read from the stored offer, not from the input.

tools.name: get_payment_link
tools.description: Creates the link to the agency's payment page for the selected offer. After this the selection of the run can no longer be changed. findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "search_field_options" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.
